comments: a0d7c4f5: This routine selects deficiencies for a report, allows user to filter by multiple criteria.
e0e695b7: If multiple divisions are selected, go through division selection process.
6a569145: If not multiple divisions, automatically select the first division.
14dee6d6: Invoke the appropriate deficiency list based on user selection.
a2229520: Prompt for date range for the report.
f491aeee: Select specific deficiency types to include in the report.
b482214a: Allow user to further refine their selection criteria.
59185a38: Notify user that the report format is designed for 132 column output.
d75e20aa: Set up report date to current date.
a3367fcd: Prepare variables for report generation and initiate device handling.
b873b918: Exit point for the routine.
b4043d24: Start processing the records for the report.
290ba0f9: If the report is for physicians or combined, go to detailed physician report processing.
5c72aca2: If the report is for services, go to service report processing.
cbc61bb6: Display message if no records match the selection criteria.
43c20438: Common exit point to clean up and quit the routine.
31da0e83: Subroutine for service selection process.
58349935: Ensure a valid admission episode is selected.
c7b3bedb: Look up the treating specialty changes for the admission.
1c1d35b4: Retrieve the ward information.
ea992790: Set the division based on the ward's division.
b08e3e20: Retrieve division-specific information.
db7b8c3d: Determine the service responsible for the patient's care.
8a9920f2: Fallback to a default service if none is found.
e870a2be: Set the specialty based on the patient's treating specialty.
7120bf4a: Exit point for the service selection process.
ab1e46ba: Filter out entries not matching selected divisions.
3b4276b3: Exclude records not belonging to the selected division.
6cbd2e5b: Exclude records for divisions set to not require review if the deficiency status is 'SIGNED NO REVIEW'.
c8af8d7c: Exclude records for divisions requiring review if the deficiency status is 'REVIEWED'.
c3d11362: Exclude records if the deficiency status is 'COMPLETED'.
f103b66b: Clean up temporary variables.
4fa95cc0: Exclude records if looking for unsigned deficiencies and the record is signed.
c5945b5a: Exclude records if looking for signed deficiencies and the record is unsigned.
16eb8d53: Filter out entries not matching the selected deficiency types.
d1c90f6a: Exclude records outside of the selected date range.
fe374bad: For physician reports, exclude records of physicians not selected.
71900f58: For patient reports, exclude records of patients not selected.
5e27c8ac: Exclude summary records if not looking for summarized deficiencies.
7925b223: Prepare division totals for output.
445a7f97: Set up patient information for display in the report.
14e1f7d3: Store physician-oriented records for the report.
51f45ebc: Store patient-oriented records for the report.
37c41a38: Process and store service-oriented records for the report.
c6f684ec: Filter out services not selected by the user.
6a543a6e: Filter out specialties not selected by the user.
6816afd1: Exit the check routine if the record is to be filtered out.
76819843: Final processing for service-oriented records.
4d179b34: Exit point for the check routine.
55d85e0d: Select physicians to include in the report.
7f679d24: Exit point for the physician selection process.
941c9c71: Initiate patient selection process.
67f1e7bc: Exit point for the patient selection process.
a28d0375: Select services to include in the report.
d5756d9a: Select specialties to include in the report.
4c17556f: Exit point for service and specialty selection process.
